title: C26 Q7: a liquidation-band proxy at the DOWN-high take-outs (bands built from Binance open-interest rises, 72h window)

what.name: Events
what.value_plain: C26 held highs taken out in a DOWN phase (phase1_recent.py), 15m Binance spot BTCUSDT
what.label: OURS

what.name: Band proxy
what.value_plain: a liquidation band is where leveraged entries would be liquidated: each 15m open-interest rise is spread over 10x/25x/50x/100x liquidation prices in 100 USD buckets, decays over the window, dies when price trades through it (a CoinGlass-heatmap-like model; nothing from CoinGlass itself)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Strong band
what.value_plain: top 20 % of bucket density within 5 % of price, from bars before the take-out only
what.label: OURS

what.name: Outcome read
what.value_plain: single short: first 15m close back under H1, stop H1 + 1.0 %, target L1, 24h time stop, fee-net
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10 % per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: phase1_liq_look.py <repo> <cache> --until 2026-11-01T07:45 --window 72 --card <this file>; open interest from the Binance USDT-M 5m metrics files. Shot fd1787b08c1b (CoinGlass Legend 15m heatmap) is what the proxy imitates; `--standing` prints today's bands.
window: RECENT design window 2026-06-21 .. 2026-11-01 (SEEN: looked at here, nothing here is evidence; DEV scores come from phase3_dev.py, card c26-h1-structural-lower-high)

verdict.label: Design look on SEEN, n=30: excursions that reached the short band above H1: 14: 7 L1, +0.24, overshoot 1.16; that stopped short of it: 11: 7 L1, +0.52, overshoot 0.48; base rate of a strong band within 0.5 % above price 10 %

why: The band above H1 marks how far the take-out overshoots: when the excursion stops short of the band the single short wins, when it reaches the band it loses on average.

A strong band stands close above price most of the time (base rate), so 'a band is there' is not a filter; 'the excursion reached it' is a candidate for the Phase 3b card (band consumed -> reclaim under H1 -> short, stop above the band top).
OURS proxy, not the vendor's heatmap: the Binance liquidation log (Lenovo, runtime_data/liq_events) is the stable source to compare against.
